Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Finn Allen will open the batting for New Zealand. Mark Adair will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! For the first time in the series, Ireland have batted first and have posted a total of 174 runs! We have witnessed scores over 170 not being chased down. Can New Zealand do so? We will know soon! Stay tuned for the second essay!

Paul Stirling is down for a chat. He says it was quite a tricky start and they thought they will build a platform for the rest of the team to play freely. Says they were looking for 160 but the partnership towards the end really pushed them to a competitive total. Adds the total is competitive and they will look to come out and bowl well to restrict New Zealand on this wicket.

New Zealand bowlers will be absolutely disappointed that they find themselves in such a tricky position. They looked comfortable in the game with Ireland reeling at 116 for 6 in 16.3 overs. They missed their line and lengths towards the end and lacked discipline. Blair Tickner and Ish Sodhi contributed with 2 wickets each. Despite the poor end to their bowling performance, they will be aware that the target is not out of reach. Please join us for the run chase.

Ireland openers began in contrasting fashion as Paul Stirling looked at his attacking best. The skipper on the other hand could not connect too many deliveries and departed after playing a slow knock. Lorcan Tucker and Harry Tector played useful cameos but it was the unbeaten 58-run partnership between Mark Adair and Curtis Campher that pushed them over the 150 mark. Mark Adair scored 37 of 15 deliveries and was ably supported by Curtis Campher who added 19 of 8 balls.

After a blistering start, Ireland have finished on a strong note as well. They would be relatively happy with their batting effort after winning the toss. They have set up a fighting total and New Zealand will know that this target of 175 will not be very easy to achieve. They will come out with positive intent and try to seal the sweep of the tour.
A yorker, around middle. Mark Adair flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Ireland end at 174 for 6!
Back of a length, outside off. Mark Adair looks to pull this one but he fails to get any bat on it. Dot ball!
No ball! Full, around middle. Mark Adair drives it to the fielder at cover. Mark Adair has overstepped here and a no ball is called! Free Hit comping up!
SIX! Up and away! Shorter again, around middle. Mark Adair stands tall and slaps this high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Shorter one, around middle. Mark Adair looks to pull this one but he misses.
FOUR! Hammered! On a length, outside off. Mark Adair makes room and slashes it powerfully past point for a boundary.
A fuller one, around middle. Curtis Campher knocks it towards long on for a single.

DROPPED! What an effort from Glenn Phillips in the deep! A very, very tough chance! He has done extremely well to save the six here! A shorter one, around middle. Mark Adair pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips there, jumps high, and takes a one-handed stunner. He realizes his momentum was taking him beyond the boundary and he immediately throws the ball back into play. Two taken in the end!
Another swing and a miss! On a length, slower one, outside off. Mark Adair once again looks to slash this but he misses.
On a length, outside off. Mark Adair looks to cut this one but he misses!
SIX! Another maximum! 16 runs off the over already! A low full toss, around middle. Mark Adair tonks it over long on for a biggie!
FOUR! Crunched! Overpitched this time, around off. Mark Adair makes room and smashes this one past mid off for a boundary.
SIX! KABOOM! A full toss now, down the leg side. Mark Adair walks across and scoops it high over fine leg for a biggie! An excellent catch taken from a member in the crowd!
Good running! On a length, around middle. Curtis Campher makes room and drags it with the inner half of his bat towards deep square leg for a brace. 19 runs off the over!
No ball! Fuller one, wide of off. Curtis Campher leaves it alone. Blair Tickner has overstepped here and a no ball is called! Free Hit coming up!
FOUR! Another boundary! What an over this is turning out to be for Ireland! Full and around off. Curtis Campher makes room and slams it wide of mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away! Too short this time, around middle and off. Curtis Campher picks up the length and smashes this towards deep square leg for a cracking boundary.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Curtis Campher shimmies down the pitch and looks to pull this but the ball goes off his inner half just away from mid on. Two taken!
SIX! Top shot! He connects it this time! A fuller one, down the leg side. Curtis Campher gets low and scoops it towards fine leg all the way for a biggie!
On a length, outside off, touch slow. Curtis Campher walks across and goes for the scoop shot but he fails to get any bat on it.
SIX! KABOOM! Fuller now, on middle. Mark Adair makes room and smokes this one over long off for a biggie. An eventful over comes to an end!
Tad slower, on a length, around off. Mark Adair shuffles across and scoops it towards fine leg. Two taken!
Outside off, short again. Mark Adair looks to cut this one but he misses.
Mark Adair is the new batter to make his way out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Jacob Duffy gets his man! Harry Tector tries to go big again but he holes out this time. Jacob Duffy drops it short again, slower one, around middle. Harry Tector looks to pull this one but the ball goes more off his top half of the blade and flies high towards deep mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips takes a good catch there! Ireland lose their sixth!
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is good from Ireland! Pitches this one up, around off. Harry Tector dances down the pitch and drills it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Crunched! A shorter one, around middle. Harry Tector makes rooms and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Curtis Campher walks out to the middle.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Ireland are losing their way here! Another batter goes back to the hut. Lovely delivery! Slower through the air, full, a googly this time, around off. George Dockrell waits for it and looks to dispatch this one over mid-wicket but gets undone as the ball spin in, beats his blade and knocks the stumps. Ireland are 5 down!
Shorter one, outside off. George Dockrell stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but the ball goes off his under edge onto the deck and over the keeper. No run taken!
Tosses this one up, full and around off. Harry Tector steps down and looks to go over cover but the ball goes off his inner half towards long on for a single.
Firing it on the pads, shorter one. George Dockrell tucks it towards short fine leg for a single.

Back of a length, outside off. George Dockrell uses the depth of his crease and punches it towards cover. A little fumble there by there by the fielder allows the batters to come back for the second run.
A leg-break, shorter one, outside off. George Dockrell pushes it off the back foot towards cover. A dot to begin with!
James Neesham serves this a fraction short and outside off, Harry Tector looks to stroke this through the offside and gets beaten.
This is on a good length outside off, George Dockrell works this towards point for a single.
This one is short and angling down leg, George Dockrell ducks under this a looks at the umpire for a wide. The umpire's arms stay down.
Bangs this one in short outside off, George Dockrell goes for another swing and misses.
This is full outside off, Harry Tector works this in the gap between point and cover for a single.
James Neesham begins with a good length delivery outside off, Harry Tector charges down the wicket and look to pull but misses.

FOUR! That is a beautiful shot hit straight down the ground! Mitchell Santner serevs this a fraction short and in line with the stumps, George Dockrell uses the crease and goes back to slap the ball past the bowler to his right for a boundary towards long on.
Another shorter ball, outside off. George Dockrell makes room and cuts it towards cover. James Neesham there makes a good stop!
Back of a length, around middle. Harry Tector backs away and nudges it towards mid-wicket. Only a single.
Another flatter one, quick, around middle and leg. Harry Tector makes room and looks to knock this one the leg side, but the ball goes off his leading edge towards point for a couple of runs.
Shorter ball, outside off. Harry Tector makes room and cuts it towards point.
Shorter one, around middle. Harry Tector blocks it out.
Mitchell Santner brings himself back into the attack!
This one is a fraction short and Daryl Mitchell sees the batter making room and follows him. George Dockrell lets the ball go through to the keeper.
WIDE! Pulls his length back once again and angles this down leg, The umpire calls this one wide.

This could have been another wicket! Daryl Mitchell serves this one a good length and straight, George Dockrell looks to make room and thump this through cover. Gets a bottom edge high over short third man and lands safely. They take a couple of runs.
George Dockrell is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Daryl Mitchell strikes in his first over! Ireland seems to be losing their way a bit! Daryl Mitchell serves this back of a length outside off, Gareth Delany goes on his toes to fend it and gets cramped for space. There is some extra bounce as well and he only manages to chop the ball back onto his stumps. New Zealand taking wickets in regular intervals now.
This is on a good length outside off, Harry Tector comes down the wicket and tries to play this leg side. Mistimes it towards square leg for a single.
Daryl Mitchell serves this on a good length in line with the stumps. Gareth Delany taps it with soft hands towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Daryl Mitchell begins with a length ball, on the pads. Harry Tector flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Daryl Mitchell comes into the attack.
Tad shorter, a googly, on the pads. Harry Tector knocks it down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off. Gareth Delany drives it right of the fielder at cover and takes a single.
Tosses this one up, full and outside off. Gareth Delany drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, drifting in, onto the pads. Harry Tector tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker, outside off, tad shorter. Harry Tector looks to slash this one away but he misses.
FOUR! Oh, good shot! Full and wide of off. Harry Tector lunges forward and drives it over cover for a glorious boundary.
In the air....and safe! A length ball, around off. Harry Tector looks to heave this one but the ball goes off his leading edge and falls behind the short third man fielder. Only a single!
Swing and a miss! Short and wide of off. Harry Tector stays in his crease and looks to go over cover but he misses.
Gareth Delany comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ireland lose two wickets in a hurry and both the set batters have departed! Blair Tickner serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Lorcan Tucker looks to loft this leg side but manages to find a leading edge towards third man. The ball is high in the air and Jacob Duffy does well to place himself under it and take it comfortably. Ireland now three down and will have to rebuild.
Commentary.Howout: c Jacob Duffy b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Blair Tickner goes for the effort ball and fraction full and outside off, Lorcan Tucker pushes at it and is beaten on the outside edge.
This is full outside off, Harry Tector guides this past point for another single.
Blair Tickner goes full on the pads, Lorcan Tucker clips this wide of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Harry Tector is the new man in!
Blair Tickner comes back to bowl!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ish Sodhi has the last laugh! He gets rid of the dangerous, Paul Stirling. A fullish ball, outside off, extra bounce there as well. Paul Stirling hangs back and looks to guide this one down to third man, but he manages to get again outside edge back to the keeper. Dane Cleaver takes a good catch!
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it up, full and around middle. Lorcan Tucker sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tighter line! Around off, quicker, and shorter. Lorcan Tucker hangs back and taps it towards point.
Well bowled! Tosses it up now, a googly, around middle. Paul Stirling leans to drive this but the ball goes off his inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! He had made that look so easy! Fuller, outside off. Paul Stirling makes room and slaps it over deep cover for a biggie.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Paul Stirling pushes it towards mid off.
Flights this one high and full outside off, Lorcan Tucker goes for another powerful drive but only manages to mistime it towards point.

FOUR! Make that three in a row! What wonderful batting as he picks the full delivery on leg and punches this through cover for the third boundary of the over! Lorcan Tucker is looking in good touch and it seems to be a master stroke to promote him up the order.in

FOUR! What a shot from Lorcan Tucker! Mitchell Santner goes a fraction short and fires this towards the pads. Lorcan Tucker reverse sweeps this past backward point for a well-taken boundary! What a start for Lorcan Tucker!
FOUR! Top shot! Loopy ball, full and around off. Lorcan Tucker gets down on his knee and sweeps it in the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter one, around off. Paul Stirling steps down, makes room and lifts it towards long off. The ball goes one bounce to the fielder there. Only a single.
Flatter, and quicker, down the leg side. Paul Stirling looks to slog this one but he misses and gets hit high on his thigh pads.

FOUR! This is has been dispatched! A good end to the over for Ireland! Ish Sodhi goes full and just outside off, Lorcan Tucker goes on one knee and sweeps this towards the deep square leg boundary for four runs!
Another loopy one, tad shorter, around middle. Paul Stirling pushes it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Tosses it up, full and outside off. Lorcan Tucker pushes it towards long on and rotates the strike!
Much fuller now, outside off. Lorcan Tucker gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps it to the fielder at short third man.
Ish Sodhi drops it short now, around middle and off. Paul Stirling uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Begins with a googly, around middle. Lorcan Tucker flicks it off the back foot towards deep square leg for a single.
Ish Sodhi has been brought into the attack.
Stick to his length, as he serves another short ball, outside off. Paul Stirling pushes it to the fielder at cover this time.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Lorcan Tucker knocks it through cover for a single.
This one is a fraction short outside off, Paul Stirling uses the crease and pushes it to deep cover for a single.
This is served quicker outside off, Paul Stirling punches this straight to point.
Quicker, flatter and on middle. Paul Stirling blocks it out.

SIX! Paul Stirling has welcomed Mitchell Santner with a maximum! Mitchell Santner serves this full in line with the stumps, Paul Stirling gets on his knees and slogs this over the cow-corner fence for a biggie!

FOUR! Nicely done! A boundary to end the Powerplay! This is slightly short and outside off. Lorcan Tucker opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a boundary. Ireland are 42 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Lorcan Tucker shuffles across and tries to scoop this one over short fine leg but he fails to get any connection on that.
Pulls his length back now, serves it around his hips. Paul Stirling tucks it towards fine leg and takes a single.
Full, angling in, on the pads now. Lorcan Tucker flicks it through mid-wicket. The ball will not race away to the boundary but the batters take 3 runs. Good running!
Swing and a miss! Fuller one now, wide of off. Lorcan Tucker presses forward and looks to drive this away from his body but he fails to get any bat on it.
On a length, outside off. Paul Stirling dabs it towards backward point for a single.
Well bowled! A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Lorcan Tucker looks to block this but he bails out in the end.
Lorcan Tucker walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Andy Balbirnie's troubled innings has come to an end! This has been a difficult outing for the skipper! Blair Tickner serves this on a good length outside off, Andy Balbirnie looks to power this over mid on but does not connect well. The ball lobs up into the air and Michael Bracewell does a good job diving to his left at mid on and grasping it with both hands! Ireland have lost their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: This one is short as well and wide outside off, Andy Balbirnie swings wildly and gets a thick edge over the slip fielder for a boundary to third man! Andy Balbirnie seems to be really struggling here!
Blair Tickner bangs this in short outside off, Andy Balbirnie charges down the wicket and swings. Gets beaten once again.
This is one a good length outside off, Andy Balbirnie looks to drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Blair Tickner serves a short and wide delivery outside off, Paul Stirling works this to wide third man for a single.
Slightly short, outside off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Play and a miss! Good-length delivery, angling away, outside off. Andy Balbirnie stays in his crease and misses his drive for the third time in this over.
On a length, around off. Paul Stirling hangs back and steers it down to third man for a run.
Much fuller this time, around middle. Andy Balbirnie pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Action reply of the previous delivery! Another good-length delivery, outside off, shaping away a tad. Andy Balbirnie once again looks to drive this one but he misses.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie looks to drive this on the up, but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
James Neesham comes into the attack.
This one is outside off and on a good length. Andy Balbirnie guides this to third man for a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery angled into the pads, Andy Balbirnie does not seem to be able to connect the ball as he gets hit on the thigh this time.

FOUR! Makes the most of the Free Hit to get off the mark! Jacob Duffy goes for a yorker but serves a full delivery that Andy Balbirnie thumps through covers for a boundary! Andy Balbirnie needed this Free Hit!
NO BALL! Jacob Duffy pulls his length back a bit and aims for the batter but oversteps in the process. Andy Balbirnie gets hit hard on the midriff.
Good line this time just outside off on a good length. Andy Balbirnie hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten.
This is full as well and still going down leg. Andy Balbirnie does not get bat to it as it hits his pads once more.
WIDE! Strays down leg once more and this has been called wide by the umpire.
This is full and angling down leg. Andy Balbirnie looks to clip this leg side and misses. Hits him on his pads.
On a length, down the leg side. Paul Stirling tucks it towards the fielder at short fine leg. He wanted a single there but he was sent back in time. 8 runs off Blair Tickner's first over!
Fuller one, around off. Paul Stirling pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Paul Stirling! Outside off again, pulls his length back now. Paul Stirling cuts it wide of backward point for a boundary. Good start from Ireland!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Another fuller one, outside off. Paul Stirling leans forward a tad, and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Overpitched again, on middle, at 138.1 clicks. Paul Stirling pushes it back to the bowler.
Blair Tickner begins with a fuller ball, around middle, tailing back in a tad. Paul Stirling blocks it out.
Blair Tickner will bowl from the other end.
This is a fraction short and angling into the pads, Paul Stirling flicks this towards backward square leg for a single.
Jacob Duffy serves this wide outside off and on a good length. Paul Stirling slashes this towards cover-point and some good fielding by James Neesham saves a boundary.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Paul Stirling! He is looking to leave a good length delivery outside off. Gets the bottom edge of the bat and goes between slip and gully for a streaky boundary towards third man.
On a good length and outside off, Paul Stirling looks to play at it and is beaten on the outside edge.

SIX! That is huge! Jacob Duffy strays down leg side on a good length, Paul Stirling clips this off his legs and deposits it over the fine leg boundary for a biggie! Paul Stirling is off the mark in style.
Jacob Duffy serves this a fraction short outside off, Paul Stirling leaves the ball by playing inside the line.
We are all set for action! The players have made their way out to the middle. Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling will open the batting for Ireland. Jacob Duffy will begin with the ball. Let's go!

PITCH REPORT - Isobel Joyce is pitchside. She says it's a new wicket, but the dimensions are quite similar. Adds that the wicket is quite firm and hard, with less grass and only a few cracks. Mentions that these are good conditions for batting and the captain winning the toss should bat first.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Dane Cleaver (WK), Glenn Phillips, Daryl Mitchell, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (C), Ish Sodhi, Blair Tickner (In for Lockie Ferguson), Jacob Duffy.

Ireland (Unchanged Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Gareth Delany, Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Curtis Campher, Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Craig Young, Josh Little.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

In the previous two games, we have witnessed a sticky and slow pitch that has not been assisting the batters. Will it be the same in the final T20I? We will find out. Stay tuned for the crucial toss and other updates.

New Zealand have been exceptional thus far. They have scored over 170 runs on a pitch that has not been easy to bat on and they have done so in both games. Different players have stepped up with the bat while it’s been a collective performance from the bowlers. They will want to replicate the same kind of show and make it 6 out of 6 wins on their tour to Ireland.
